column.statusHelp1: The system column status determines how the system counts tasks inside it.
column.statusHelp2: It affects progress calculation, filtering, and automated actions on the board.
column.statusHelp3: Columns with status "To Do" are considered starting, "In Progress" are active, and "Done" are completed.
column.statusHelp4: You can rename the column, but the system status defines its role in board logic.
column.statusHelp5: Changing this status can affect how tasks are displayed and processed.
